Music for Adam Oehlenschläger's Tragedy "Canute the Great"

history.p: "Knud den Store" (Canute the Great) belongs to the late dramas of Oehlenschläger, which failed to interest the public. Therefore it only obtained three performances before it was put aside for ever.

physDesc.physMedium: Written in brown ink. Paper: 16 staves. In upper left-hand corner of first music page: "644 P." being the archive number of The Royal Theatre (Det Kongelige Teater), and in the upper right-hand corner: "Til 'Knud den Store'". Nos. 1 & 2 paginated together. The other numbers all have their own pagination. At the end of No. 6 signed and dated: "Fine / I:P:E: Hartmann Op: 26 [recte: 28] / 16/3 39".
